_why: Skill-candidates row 'guard-census-from-the-diff': h_mad_guard_census.py lists the decision lines a diff adds or changes that no mutation row anchors. These rows prove each way it could under-report (a line wrongly anchored, a file or spec silently dropped, an unreadable input read as zero) and each decision form of the Python and shell rules is pinned by a named test.

mutations.name: missing-spec-dir-reads-as-no-anchors
mutations._mechanism: A spec directory that is absent is read as zero specs: every line is a candidate and nothing says the specs were never read.

mutations.name: ambiguous-find-anchors-its-first-hit
mutations._mechanism: A find that matches twice anchors the first match, so an unappliable mutant counts as coverage.

mutations.name: stale-find-not-counted
mutations._mechanism: A find that matches nowhere vanishes without a trace on the ROWS line.

mutations.name: empty-find-treated-as-a-match
mutations._mechanism: An empty find is counted as an ambiguous match instead of stale.

mutations.name: deleted-file-read-as-a-target
mutations._mechanism: A deleted file is fetched as a census target and its missing blob is a crash.

mutations.name: symlink-read-as-source
mutations._mechanism: A symlink or submodule entry is parsed as source.

mutations.name: binary-change-read-as-source
mutations._mechanism: A binary change is decoded and parsed as source.

mutations.name: binary-not-detected-from-numstat
mutations._mechanism: The numstat binary marker is never recognised.
mutations.find: if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == b"-" and parts[1] == b"-":

mutations.name: test-files-are-targets
mutations._mechanism: Test files are census targets, flooding the list with their own assertions.

mutations.name: non-utf8-python-skipped-silently
mutations._mechanism: A decode failure escapes as a crash instead of UNREADABLE.

mutations.name: unparseable-python-skipped-silently
mutations._mechanism: A file that does not parse is read as having no decisions instead of UNREADABLE.
mutations.find: raise Unreadable("unreadable-file", f"{path}: does not parse ({type(exc).__name__})") from exc

mutations.name: non-utf8-shell-skipped
mutations._mechanism: A shell file that is not UTF-8 is silently dropped from the census.
mutations.find: raise Unreadable("unreadable-file", f"{ch.path}: not UTF-8") from exc

mutations.name: unchanged-lines-are-decisions
mutations._mechanism: A decision on an unchanged line counts: the census stops being about the diff.

mutations.name: single-line-hunk-count-read-as-zero
mutations._mechanism: A hunk header without a count (one line) is read as no lines.
mutations.find: count = 1 if hit.group(2) is None else int(hit.group(2))

mutations.name: python-line-never-anchored
mutations._mechanism: No Python line is ever anchored, whatever the specs hold.

mutations.name: elif-reported-as-if
mutations._mechanism: An elif is reported as a plain if.

mutations.name: elif-is-an-arm
mutations._mechanism: A branch header is annotated as an arm of an anchored guard, which invites skipping a decision of its own.
mutations.find: (d.kind.split(",")[0] not in HEADERS and d.parent is not None and d.parent_span

mutations.name: arm-annotation-dropped
mutations._mechanism: The arm annotation and its count disappear.

mutations.name: continuation-line-not-considered
mutations._mechanism: Only the first line of a multi-line statement can anchor it.

mutations.name: marker-comment-anchors
mutations._mechanism: A `# M:` marker in the line counts as an anchor.
mutations.replace: if spans.overlaps(lo, hi) or "# M:" in text[lo:hi]:

mutations.name: one-case-arm-anchors-the-line
mutations._mechanism: A single case arm with a row anchors a line that has several.
mutations.find: hit = all(spans.overlaps(a, b) for a, b in arms) if arms else \
mutations.replace: hit = any(spans.overlaps(a, b) for a, b in arms) if arms else \

mutations.name: shell-comment-is-a-decision
mutations._mechanism: A comment that looks like code is a shell decision.
mutations.find: if not s or s.startswith("#") or _NOISE.match(s) or _FUNC.match(s):

mutations.name: shell-function-header-is-a-decision
mutations._mechanism: A function header named like a verdict helper is a decision.
mutations.find: if not s or s.startswith("#") or _NOISE.match(s) or _FUNC.match(s):
mutations.replace: if not s or s.startswith("#") or _NOISE.match(s):

mutations.name: shell-control-not-a-decision
mutations._mechanism: if/for/case lines are not shell decisions.

mutations.name: shell-test-not-a-decision
mutations._mechanism: [ ] and [[ ]] tests are not shell decisions.

mutations.name: shell-andor-not-a-decision
mutations._mechanism: && and || lines are not shell decisions.
mutations.find: if "&&" in s or "||" in s:

mutations.name: shell-arm-not-a-decision
mutations._mechanism: Case arms are not shell decisions.

mutations.name: shell-jump-not-a-decision
mutations._mechanism: return/exit/break/continue are not shell decisions.

mutations.name: shell-assign-not-a-decision
mutations._mechanism: Assignments are not shell decisions.

mutations.name: shell-verdict-call-not-a-decision
mutations._mechanism: _refuse/_allow calls are not shell decisions.

mutations.name: suffixless-file-always-shell
mutations._mechanism: Every suffix-less changed file is read as a shell script.
mutations.find: return "." not in posixpath.basename(path) and SHELL_HEAD.match(blob.split(b"\n", 1)[0]) is not None

mutations.name: git-failure-read-as-empty-output
mutations._mechanism: A failing git is read as empty output.

mutations.name: bad-ref-reported-as-git
mutations._mechanism: A bad ref loses its own reason.
mutations.find: raise Unreadable("bad-ref", f"not a commit: {ref!r}") from exc
mutations.replace: raise Unreadable("git", f"not a commit: {ref!r}") from exc

mutations.name: literal-pathspecs-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Glob characters in a path are read as a pattern.

mutations.name: malformed-row-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A row without a string file/find is a crash, not UNREADABLE.
mutations.find:
if (not isinstance(row_doc, dict) or not isinstance(row_doc.get("file"), str)
                    or not isinstance(row_doc.get("find"), str)):

mutations.name: non-spec-json-read-as-spec
mutations._mechanism: A JSON data file in the spec directory is read as a spec.
mutations.find: if not isinstance(doc, dict) or not isinstance(doc.get("mutations"), list):

mutations.name: absolute-root-outside-repo-trusted
mutations._mechanism: A spec whose absolute root is elsewhere is mapped into this repository.

mutations.name: outside-spec-dir-crashes
mutations._mechanism: A spec directory outside the repository is a crash, not UNREADABLE.

            raise Unreadable("spec-dir"
mutations.replace:

            raise Unreadable("spec-dir"

mutations.name: unreadable-exits-zero
mutations._mechanism: A cannot-judge exits 0.

mutations.name: cannot-judge-carries-a-count
mutations._mechanism: A cannot-judge renders the counted line.
